summary:
Builder 1's step for M4 is done and checked in the worktree (C:\Users\louis\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-louis-Documents-RANDOM-ROBLOX\93ae48b4-72b9-4dc1-aa5d-451af1abf9a0\scratchpad\m4-wt). The last run of `lune run scripts/verify -- --quick` passed (exit 0, 746 pass, 0 fail).

**What was resuming:**
- **Slice 2 was already built but not in my notes.** I checked every touched file against the plan.
- **The half-merged guard was broken.** Runner.spec still used its own variable name, and its verify case was matching code that no longer exists, so that case would have failed. It now uses Test.SELFTEST_CHILD everywhere.

**The guard now works in three places, each with a test:**
- **Runner.spec** spawns nothing when the variable is set (tested in-process).
- **tests/run**, under the variable, refuses any root that holds the self-test (a spec at Meta/Runner.spec.luau). That covers tests/, tests/Meta and any parent folder. It is tested on a small stand-in root, tools/runner-selftest/holder, which a broken check would run and then exit 0.
- **scripts/verify**, under the variable, runs no stage and exits 2, naming the test command it would have run. This check comes before its repo-root check. The self-test runs verify from tools/, so a verify that lost its guard still stops at the repo-root check.

**Every runner Runner.spec spawns now names a root under tools/runner-selftest/, the exit-2 cases included.** New roots: nospec, bless (the --bless probe moved there) and holder.

**Mutants were re-run under the safety rules.** They ran only on a copy without the .git file. Each run was capped at 120 s in a Windows job object, so a stuck run's whole process tree is killed by its PID. 40 mutants: none hung, none left a process. One survived at first (Params' x clamp); I tightened Params.spec and then all 40 were caught.

**Finding:** passing variables through Lune 0.8.9's spawn option `env` costs about 85 ms per child. The self-test now sets them in its own process around each spawn. Runner.spec's cost on the quick run is back to f7ac37d's (1,219 vs 1,215 ms per case total), despite 9 more spawns.

**Slices 1 and 2** (Types, Rng, Params, Checks, D3's two rows, fingerprint re-bless) match the plan's numbers. Rng gives 0 differences from the prototype, and every χ² equals critic B's precompute. M4's share of the quick run is 0.15 s by the runner (0.90–0.95 s wall).

M4-notes has a builder 1 section (including the incident) and M4-handoff has all my SPEC, evidence and README edits. No process of mine is running.
